mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, email, password, refresh_token, user_type, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND password = #{password} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT user_id, login_id, email, password, refresh_token, user_type, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT user_id, login_id, email, password, refresh_token, user_type, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( login_id, email, password, user_type, name, phone, birth_date, profile_image_url, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{userType}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birthDate}, #{profileImageUrl}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )
